resources.string: Profiles and FPS settings for your phone
Storage is almost full. Worlds and mods can fail to save.
The class comes from CPU speed, RAM and Android version. The GPU cannot be read before the game starts, so it is not counted.
Custom: change anything yourself in Minecraft\'s video settings and the launcher settings. Profiles only apply when you tap Apply.
Very short render distance, minimal particles, 60 FPS cap, lower resolution. For weak phones.
Everyday play: medium distance, fewer particles, FPS capped to your screen.
Most FPS: short entity and simulation distance (helps TNT, minecarts, mobs), minimal particles, no clouds, no FPS cap.
Fancy graphics, longer distance, full resolution, for strong phones.
This is more than half of your RAM. Android may close the game; lower it.
This changes the video options of "%1$s" (distance, particles, clouds, FPS cap and more), sets game RAM to %2$d MB and resolution to %3$d %%. A copy of options.txt is kept so you can restore it.
This instance has no options.txt yet. Start the game once, close it, then apply a profile.
The options already matched, nothing changed in options.txt.
RAM %1$d MB, resolution %2$d %%. Changes in options.txt:

• Lower Simulation distance: fewer entities and TNT are calculated.
• Lower Entity distance and Particles for big explosions and many minecarts.
• Lower the resolution scale: the biggest FPS gain on phones.
• Keep RAM near the advised value. More is not faster on Android.
• In the game, Quick settings has Performance mode: 70 % resolution and the Performance profile.
Puts back options.txt from before the profile and resets RAM, resolution and custom JVM arguments to the launcher defaults.
Restore the saved options.txt and the launcher defaults for RAM, resolution and JVM arguments?
Launcher defaults restored. There was no saved options.txt.
Replay Mod can export videos. The launcher gives the game the path to FFmpeg when it starts.
Replay Mod needs the FFmpeg plugin app (package git.mojo.ffmpeg) to export. Tap Install below. Android asks you to confirm once, then it is ready.

1. Install the Replay Mod for your Minecraft version (Browse → Mods).
2. Record in game, open the replay and choose Render.
3. Wait for the render to finish. Keep the screen on and the phone cool: rendering is heavy.
4. Come back here and save the video to your gallery.
No videos yet in this instance (folder replay_videos).
Delete this video file? This cannot be undone.
1 finger paints. 2 fingers rotate and zoom. Turn a part off to reach what is behind it.

This game was started with the account \"%1$s\", and that account keeps its skin on its own server (Ely.by or Microsoft). A running game cannot change it. Change the skin in the launcher Wardrobe, or start the game with an offline account to pick skins here.
Skin "%1$s" set. Press F3 + T in game to reload it.
Donate if you can. It helps us put the app on the Play Store.

Spirit Launcher is free and always will be. If you can, donate any amount with UPI (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm...) by scanning this code. Once we have enough money for the Play Store developer account, we will publish the app there. Thank you!
Only vanilla, Fabric and Quilt instances can be switched here. Forge and NeoForge need their own installer: make a new instance for them.
Now using %1$s. Press Save to keep it.
Your loader is too old (needs %1$s or newer)
A mod needs a newer Fabric/Quilt loader than the one this instance uses. Updating the loader fixes it; your worlds and mods stay.
Loader updated: %1$s. Launch the game again.
Fixes applied, go back and launch
Download the FFmpeg plugin (from the MojoLauncher project on GitHub) and install it? Android will ask you to confirm the install.
Could not download the plugin: %1$s\n\nYou can get it from the releases page instead.
Allow installs from Spirit Launcher on the page that opened, then press Install again.
A ready control layout for recording and moving the camera in Replay Mod.
Install the Replay Mod Control layout? If you already installed it, it is replaced with the original. Pick it afterwards in Custom controls.
Replay_Control installed. Pick it in Custom controls.
Checks your phone and sets the memory that suits it best.
Memory set to %1$d MB (phone has %2$d MB, %3$d MB free now)
RAM %1$d MB, %2$d MB free · Android %3$s · %4$d cores\nBest for this phone: %5$d MB · Now: %6$d MB
Uses the phone\'s call audio mode, which often removes echo of the game sound in your mic. Headphones work best. If game sound becomes quiet, turn it off.
Removes downloaded installers, old logs and crash reports of the selected instance. Worlds and mods are not touched.
Applies the next time the game starts
Drag the FPS, RAM and gear buttons to move them. Pinch one with two fingers to resize it. Tap FPS or RAM to shrink it to the number only.
